title: Tellersonne
description: A calm cooking app for iOS, Android and tablets, with public recipe pages and a web admin panel. No ads, no third-party analytics.

features.name: Apps for phone and tablet
features.description: One codebase for iOS, Android and tablets.

features.name: Public recipe pages
features.description: Recipes can be opened in the browser without the app.

features.name: Web admin panel
features.description: Recipes and content are managed in a separate admin area.

features.name: No tracking
features.description: No ads and no third-party analytics.

developmentProcess: Tellersonne is the project I spend most of my time on right now. The repository is private, so this page only covers what is public: the apps and the recipe pages at tellersonne.app.

title: VectoBeat
description: Discord music bot with Lavalink v4 audio, playlists, fast queue handling and a dynamic equalizer, plus a Next.js control panel.

features.name: Lavalink v4 audio
features.description: Playback runs on a Lavalink v4 node.

features.name: Playlists and queue
features.description: Saved playlists and a queue that stays responsive on large servers.

features.name: Dynamic equalizer
features.description: Sound presets that can be changed while a track plays.

features.name: Control panel
features.description: A Next.js web panel for server settings.

developmentProcess: VectoBeat started as a music bot for my own Discord server. The bot is written in Python with discord.py, the control panel in Next.js.

title: VectolynCloud
description: Kit for running your own Minecraft network. Its own cloud manages proxies, servers and plugins, and Java and Bedrock players play together.
status: Open source, OpenSSF Best Practices passing

features.name: Own cloud system
features.description: Starts and manages proxies, game servers and plugins.

features.name: Java and Bedrock
features.description: Players on Java and Bedrock Edition join the same network.

features.name: OpenSSF Best Practices
features.description: The project holds the OpenSSF Best Practices badge at passing level.

developmentProcess: VectolynCloud builds on what I learned running the PlayGS network from 2017 to 2019, written down as a reusable kit.

features.name: API and bot in one

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: A web dashboard ships with the API.
